# Owen Ford & Susan

- [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) — Friend of — [Susan](../character/susan.md) — admires him and his compliments on her cooking · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) drops off [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) at Anne's house so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can guide him to Leslie's, where he will be boarding. While walking him over, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Owen chat about the area's history and his hopes of finding inspiration for a novel. Upon arriving, Owen is struck by Leslie's beauty and meets the Moore household.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) visit Captain Jim at [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point), where Captain Jim realizes Owen is the grandson of the schoolmaster's bride from his past. Captain Jim entertains his guests with numerous sea tales and lends Owen his treasured life-book to read. On the walk home, Owen marvels at the captain's extraordinary life while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assures him the stories are true.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P10](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P21](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P37](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0037)_

> When [Susan](../character/susan.md) leaves temporarily to care for her injured sister, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) comes to stay at [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's house to avoid gossip and loneliness. [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) arrives to visit [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to encourage [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to embrace her feelings and the future ahead of her.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P25](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P28](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P49](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0049)_

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) declares his love for [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) in the garden, and she eagerly confesses her love in return. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Captain Jim join them by the fire, where Captain Jim gives them a heartwarming benediction before taking his final leave from their house. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) welcomes [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to stay with them, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with news and commentary.
>
